description: Signed division rounded to the nearest integer, halves away from zero (DIV_ROUND_CLOSEST)
notes: Linux kernel v6.11, DIV_ROUND_CLOSEST macro (include/linux/math.h), instantiated with an int dividend and an int divisor: the macro's unsigned-type tests are then false, and the dividend is moved by d / 2 toward the sign of the quotient before the truncating division. Written by us from the macro. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake branches to compute d / 2 or d / -2, then one add and one sdiv: 12 IR instructions. Division by zero and INT_MIN / -1 are UB in the source. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
